verses.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ παραστῆσαι τὰ σώματα ὑμῶν θυσίαν ζῶσαν ἁγίαν τῷ Θεῷ εὐάρεστον τὴν λογικὴν λατρείαν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Parakalō oun hymas adelphoi dia tōn oiktirmōn tou Theou parastēsai ta sōmata hymōn thysian zōsan hagian tō Theō euareston tēn logikēn latreian hymōn
verses.literal: Therefore I urge you brothers on account of God’s mercy to offer your bodies as living sacrifices holy and pleasing to God which is your spiritual service of worship

verses.original: καὶ μὴ συσχηματίζεσθε τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ μεταμορφοῦσθε τῇ ἀνακαινώσει τοῦ νοός εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐάρεστον καὶ τέλειον
verses.transliteration: kai mē syschēmatizesthe tō aiōni toutō alla metamorphousthe tē anakainōsei tou noos eis to dokimazein hymas ti to thelēma tou Theou to agathon kai euareston kai teleion
verses.literal: Do not be conformed to this world but be transformed by the renewing of your mind Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good pleasing and perfect will of God

verses.original: Λέγω γὰρ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι παντὶ τῷ ὄντι ἐν ὑμῖν μὴ ὑπερφρονεῖν παρ’ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν ἀλλὰ φρονεῖν εἰς τὸ σωφρονεῖν ἑκάστῳ ὡς ὁ Θεὸς ἐμέρισεν μέτρον πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Legō gar dia tēs charitos tēs dotheisēs moi panti tō onti en hymin mē hyperphronein par’ ho dei phronein alla phronein eis to sōphronein hekastō hōs ho Theos emerisen metron pisteōs
verses.literal: For by the grace given me I say to every one - of you Do not think of yourself more highly . . . than you ought but think of yourself with sober judgment according to the measure of faith God has given you

verses.original: καθάπερ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι πολλὰ μέλη ἔχομεν τὰ δὲ μέλη πάντα οὐ τὴν αὐτὴν ἔχει πρᾶξιν
verses.transliteration: kathaper gar en heni sōmati polla melē echomen ta de melē panta ou tēn autēn echei praxin
verses.literal: Just as each of us has one body with many members and not all members have the same function

verses.original: οὕτως οἱ πολλοὶ ἓν σῶμά ἐσμεν ἐν Χριστῷ τὸ δὲ καθ’ εἷς ἀλλήλων μέλη
verses.transliteration: houtōs hoi polloi hen sōma esmen en Christō to de kath’ heis allēlōn melē
verses.literal: so in Christ we who are many are one body and each member belongs to one another

verses.original: Ἔχοντες δὲ χαρίσματα κατὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν διάφορα εἴτε προφητείαν κατὰ τὴν ἀναλογίαν τῆς πίστεως
verses.transliteration: Echontes de charismata kata tēn charin tēn dotheisan hēmin diaphora eite prophēteian kata tēn analogian tēs pisteōs
verses.literal: We have different gifts according to the grace given us If one’s gift is prophecy let him use it in proportion to his faith

verses.original: εἴτε διακονίαν ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ εἴτε ὁ διδάσκων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: eite diakonian en tē diakonia eite ho didaskōn en tē didaskalia
verses.literal: if it is serving - let him serve if it is teaching - let him teach

verses.original: εἴτε ὁ παρακαλῶν ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει ὁ μεταδιδοὺς ἐν ἁπλότητι ὁ προϊστάμενος ἐν σπουδῇ ὁ ἐλεῶν ἐν ἱλαρότητι
verses.transliteration: eite ho parakalōn en tē paraklēsei ho metadidous en haplotēti ho proistamenos en spoudē ho eleōn en hilarotēti
verses.literal: if it is encouraging - let him encourage if it is giving let him give generously if it is leading let him lead with diligence if it is showing mercy let him do it cheerfully

verses.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη ἀνυπόκριτος ἀποστυγοῦντες τὸ πονηρόν κολλώμενοι τῷ ἀγαθῷ
verses.transliteration: Hē agapē anypokritos apostygountes to ponēron kollōmenoi tō agathō
verses.literal: Love must be sincere Detest what is evil cling to what is good

verses.original: τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ εἰς ἀλλήλους φιλόστοργοι τῇ τιμῇ ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι
verses.transliteration: tē philadelphia eis allēlous philostorgoi tē timē allēlous proēgoumenoi
verses.literal: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love Outdo yourselves in honoring one another

verses.original: τῇ σπουδῇ μὴ ὀκνηροί τῷ πνεύματι ζέοντες τῷ Κυρίῳ δουλεύοντες
verses.transliteration: tē spoudē mē oknēroi tō pneumati zeontes tō Kyriō douleuontes
verses.literal: Do not let your zeal subside keep your spiritual fervor . . . . . . serving the Lord

verses.original: τῇ ἐλπίδι χαίροντες τῇ θλίψει ὑπομένοντες τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτεροῦντες
verses.transliteration: tē elpidi chairontes tē thlipsei hypomenontes tē proseuchē proskarterountes
verses.literal: Be joyful in hope patient in affliction persistent in prayer

verses.original: ταῖς χρείαις τῶν ἁγίων κοινωνοῦντες τὴν φιλοξενίαν διώκοντες
verses.transliteration: tais chreiais tōn hagiōn koinōnountes tēn philoxenian diōkontes
verses.literal: Share with the saints who are in need Practice hospitality

verses.original: Εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς διώκοντας ὑμᾶς εὐλογεῖτε καὶ μὴ καταρᾶσθε
verses.transliteration: Eulogeite tous diōkontas hymas eulogeite kai mē katarasthe
verses.literal: Bless those who persecute you Bless and do not curse

verses.original: χαίρειν μετὰ χαιρόντων κλαίειν μετὰ κλαιόντων
verses.transliteration: chairein meta chairontōn klaiein meta klaiontōn
verses.literal: Rejoice with those who rejoice weep with those who weep

verses.original: τὸ αὐτὸ εἰς ἀλλήλους φρονοῦντες μὴ τὰ ὑψηλὰ φρονοῦντες ἀλλὰ τοῖς ταπεινοῖς συναπαγόμενοι μὴ γίνεσθε φρόνιμοι παρ’ ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: to auto eis allēlous phronountes mē ta hypsēla phronountes alla tois tapeinois synapagomenoi mē ginesthe phronimoi par’ heautois
verses.literal: Live in harmony . . . . . . with one another Do not be proud . . . . . . but associate with the lowly Do not be conceited . . . . . .

verses.original: μηδενὶ κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἀποδιδόντες προνοούμενοι καλὰ ἐνώπιον πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: mēdeni kakon anti kakou apodidontes pronooumenoi kala enōpion pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Do not repay anyone . . . evil for evil Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody . . .

verses.original: εἰ δυνατόν τὸ ἐξ ὑμῶν μετὰ πάντων ἀνθρώπων εἰρηνεύοντες
verses.transliteration: ei dynaton to ex hymōn meta pantōn anthrōpōn eirēneuontes
verses.literal: If it is possible on your part live at peace with everyone . . .

verses.original: μὴ ἑαυτοὺς ἐκδικοῦντες ἀγαπητοί ἀλλὰ δότε τόπον τῇ ὀργῇ γέγραπται γάρ Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω λέγει Κύριος
verses.transliteration: mē heautous ekdikountes agapētoi alla dote topon tē orgē gegraptai gar Emoi ekdikēsis egō antapodōsō legei Kyrios
verses.literal: Do not avenge yourselves beloved but leave room for God’s wrath For it is written Vengeance is Mine I will repay says the Lord

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ Ἐὰν πεινᾷ ὁ ἐχθρός σου ψώμιζε αὐτόν ἐὰν διψᾷ πότιζε αὐτόν τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν ἄνθρακας πυρὸς σωρεύσεις ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Alla Ean peina ho echthros sou psōmize auton ean dipsa potize auton touto gar poiōn anthrakas pyros sōreuseis epi tēn kephalēn autou
verses.literal: On the contrary If your enemy is hungry feed him if he is thirsty give him a drink For in so doing . . . you will heap burning coals on his head

verses.original: Μὴ νικῶ ὑπὸ τοῦ κακοῦ ἀλλὰ νίκα ἐν τῷ ἀγαθῷ τὸ κακόν
verses.transliteration: Mē nikō hypo tou kakou alla nika en tō agathō to kakon
verses.literal: Do not be overcome by evil but overcome evil with good
